summary: 本轮增量检索收录 2 项 2026-08-19 首次公开且高度相关的新工作：`ADEPT` 聚焦用大规模强化学习把预训练和后训练结合起来，推动多自由度灵巧手在视触觉输入下完成长时序任务；`LabDex` 则提出面向化学实验室的层级式灵巧操作基准与数据集，强调真实实验室交互、长时程流程和跨平台评测。两者都把灵巧手或灵巧操作放在主线位置，因此纳入本次更新。
summary_en: This incremental pass adds 2 newly public and highly relevant items first released on 2026-08-19. `ADEPT` proposes a large-scale RL framework that combines pre-training and post-training to advance high-DoF dexterous manipulation from raw visuo-tactile input, while `LabDex` introduces a hierarchical benchmark and dataset for dexterous manipulation in chemistry laboratories with real-world lab interaction and long-horizon evaluation. Both place dexterous hands or dexterous manipulation at the center, so they are included in this update.

items.title: ADEPT: Accelerating Dexterity via Pre-Training and Post-Training using Reinforcement Learning
items.authors_or_org: Jayjun Lee, Jessica Yin, Asif Rana, Nicholas Blauch, Sam Mady, Mohak Bhardwaj, Nima Fazeli, Nathan Ratliff, Karl Van Wyk, Ankur Handa
items.relevance: 该工作直接面向多自由度灵巧手的强化学习与视触觉灵巧操作，核心贡献就是推进高维度手部策略学习，而不是泛化的机械臂操控。
items.relevance_en: This work directly targets reinforcement learning for multi-DoF dexterous hands and visuo-tactile dexterous manipulation, with the central contribution being high-dimensional hand policy learning rather than generic arm manipulation.
items.novelty_signal: arXiv 于 2026-08-19 首次公开，并明确给出可迁移的灵巧预训练/后训练框架、实体双平台实验以及项目页线索。
items.novelty_signal_en: First public on arXiv on 2026-08-19, with a transferable dexterity pretrain/post-train framework, physical experiments on two embodiments, and a linked project page.
items.analysis_zh: 这项工作主要提出一个用于灵巧操作的大规模强化学习框架 ADEPT，解决的是多自由度多指机器人在长时序任务中难以从零开始学习、且跨任务迁移时容易丢失已有灵巧技能的问题。方法上，作者先在通用物体复位任务上预训练灵巧策略，再把该策略作为先验用于下游任务后训练，并结合行为克隆蒸馏、critic warm-up 和保守的 on-policy 更新来稳定迁移；同时引入 joint-space Geometric Fabric 作为策略与机器人之间的安全与运动学调节器。实验在 23 DoF Kuka-Allegro 和 29 DoF Flexiv-Sharpa 两种实体平台上进行，配合双 RGB 相机与触觉传感，结果显示系统可以对下游任务的复位阶段实现 zero-shot，且能在挑战性初始状态下完成长时序任务。总体来看，它把“先学通用灵巧技能，再高效迁移到新任务”做成了可工作的路线，但公开摘要对具体基准、失败模式、消融细节和与更广泛方法的完整数值对比仍披露有限。
items.analysis_en: This work introduces ADEPT, a large-scale reinforcement learning framework for dexterous manipulation that addresses a core problem in multi-finger robotics: learning long-horizon behaviors from scratch is hard, and transferring dexterous skills to new tasks often destroys previously acquired capabilities. The main idea is to pretrain a dexterous policy on a generic object-reposing task and then use that policy as a prior for downstream post-training, with behavior-cloning distillation, critic warm-up, and conservative on-policy updates to stabilize transfer. The method also adds a joint-space Geometric Fabric to mediate between the RL policy and the robot’s kinematics and safety constraints. Experiments on two physical embodiments, a 23 DoF Kuka-Allegro and a 29 DoF Flexiv-Sharpa, use dual RGB cameras and vision-based tactile sensors, and the abstract reports zero-shot reposing on downstream tasks plus successful long-horizon execution from difficult initial states. The overall conclusion is that pretrain-then-post-train is a promising path for scalable dexterity, but the public abstract gives limited information about exact benchmarks, failure cases, ablation details, and broader numerical comparisons.

items.title: LabDex: A Hierarchical Benchmark for Dexterous Manipulation in Laboratories
items.authors_or_org: Zhipeng Tang, Sihang Chen, Sha Zhang, Peihao Yang, Yan Liu, Wentao Zhao, Xinrui Liu, Rui Huang, Wensheng Du, Yuting Huang, Jiajun Deng, Lidian Wang, Yuan Zhang, Yanyong Zhang
items.relevance: 该工作直接把实验室场景中的灵巧操作作为基准对象，核心是灵巧手在真实实验流程里的任务分解、评测和数据集构建。
items.relevance_en: This work treats dexterous manipulation in laboratory settings as the benchmark target, with the central contribution being task decomposition, evaluation, and dataset construction for dexterous hands in real experimental workflows.
items.novelty_signal: arXiv 于 2026-08-19 首次公开，且是面向化学实验室灵巧操作的层级式真实世界基准与数据集。
items.novelty_signal_en: First public on arXiv on 2026-08-19, and it is a hierarchical real-world benchmark and dataset focused on dexterous manipulation in chemistry laboratories.
items.analysis_zh: 这项工作主要提出 LabDex，一个面向化学实验室灵巧操作的真实世界数据集和层级式基准，解决的是现有基准无法同时覆盖灵巧手使用、真实实验室交互和多阶段实验流程的问题。方法上，作者把任务组织为三层结构：Atomic Skills、Compositional Skills 和 Long-Horizon Laboratory Workflows，并首次把真实平台和仿真平台统一到共同框架下，提供标准化任务定义、示范数据和评测协议。实验对代表性机器人学习方法做了跨层级评测，覆盖真实环境与仿真环境，结果表明该任务设计与示范数据有效，且能支持不同层级灵巧操作任务上的训练与系统评估。总体而言，LabDex 把“实验室里的灵巧手操作”从零散任务提升为可比较、可扩展的基准，但摘要没有给出具体成功率、样本规模、硬件细节或失败案例，因此对上限能力和推广边界的判断仍需后续全文。
items.analysis_en: This paper presents LabDex, a large-scale real-world dataset and benchmark for dexterous manipulation in chemistry laboratories, addressing the gap that existing benchmarks do not jointly capture dexterous hand use, real lab interactions, and multi-stage experimental procedures. The method organizes laboratory work into a three-level hierarchy, namely Atomic Skills, Compositional Skills, and Long-Horizon Laboratory Workflows, and, importantly, unifies real-world and simulation platforms under one framework with standardized task definitions, demonstrations, and evaluation protocols. The experiments perform cross-level evaluations of representative robot learning methods in both real and simulated settings, and the abstract states that the benchmark design and demonstration data are effective and that the suite supports training and systematic evaluation across laboratory dexterous manipulation tasks. The conclusion is that LabDex provides a foundation for autonomous-lab research by making dexterous manipulation in laboratories measurable and compositional, but the public abstract does not disclose concrete success rates, dataset scale, hardware specifics, or failure analysis, so the limits of generalization remain under-specified.

caveats: 本轮按既有 seen-items 状态进行增量去重。
检索范围覆盖 arXiv、会议与期刊网站、实验室与大学页面、公司研究博客、GitHub、项目页和 Hugging Face。
公开摘要对若干实验细节、失败模式和完整数值对比披露有限。
